column1: # 0.5.1 PROBE manifest - the four configurations the changed tasks are calibrated on
# before the 0.5.1 full sweep. Not a corpus: `scripts/pve_sweep.py --tasks-dir tasks_probe`
# runs only the tasks whose prompt changed in this epoch, so nothing here is published.
# Chosen for spread, not for a ranking: the 0.5.0 top scorer (bolt iq3_xxs, 86.6%),
# a mid-size capable model (lfm25-8b-a1b), a small fast one (spark 1.7B) and a
# mid scorer (gemma4-e4b). If a repaired task is failed by all four, it is still
# unwinnable and must be repaired again before the sweep spends 12 hours on it.
